what: PM2.5 24-hour AQI categories: breakpoints in force (EPA AQI technical assistance document, May 2026, Table 6, implementing 40 CFR part 58 Appendix G as revised in 2024), the EPA cautionary statement for particulate matter in each category (Table 5), and the wildfire-smoke guide's health effects and cautionary statements for each category (Table 4). guide_printed_pm25 is the guide's own Table 5 range, from before the 2024 revision, kept to show the drift; it is not a breakpoint.
